cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please say good morning to the office fern. We all do it; I can show you the proper way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good morning, fern. Now can I answer the phone?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not while you're facing away. Give it your attention, finish the greeting, then take the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caller's on hold. Shall I say good morning for them too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask them first. We don't put words in people's mouths. Then introduce them; the fern hasn't met everyone yet.
